statement: For every integer b ≥ 1 and every Dirichlet character χ modulo b, the Dirichlet L-function L(s, χ) has no zero in ℜs > 7/8. This includes imprimitive characters and the trivial character of modulus 1, whose L-function is ζ(s). A pole at s = 1 for a principal character is allowed.
